{{Top}}
{{Quote|Thank Deity that malign creature is erased from the face of the galaxy!|From the data-journal of [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]], regarding the late [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>}}
A '''deity''', also called a '''god''' (feminine '''goddess'''), was a powerful being who was worshipped by a group of followers. Known deities included the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yun'o|gods]] and the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] gods, called the [[Skyborn]], as well as the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] moon goddess [[Shiraya/Legends|Shiraya]].

The [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] believed that the gods created them so deities could have superior beings to worship.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> An individual known as [[God (extra-galactic)|God]] was part of an [[Unidentified extra-galactic race|extra-galactic race]].<ref name="Les Éclaireurs">{{CasusBelliCite|48|Les Éclaireurs de l'Alliance : La quête infinie}}</ref>
